queries.text: amount to be invested regular contributions withdrawals and adviser charges

triggerProbe.absentWhen: The recommendation involves no capital, contributions, withdrawals or charges.

queryGroups.requirement: Affordability of initial and ongoing commitments

queries.text: initial adviser fee and ongoing annual charge in monetary terms payable by you
monthly contribution you will pay into the plan regular premium
the contributions are affordable based on your income and expenditure
disposable income surplus available each month after expenditure
fees will be paid from the plan rather than directly by the client facilitated

falsePositiveGuards: Fees taken from the fund reduce the investment, not the client's income — do not test them against monthly surplus.
A one-off transfer of existing pension money is not a new affordability commitment.

sufficiency.ifAssertionAbsent: Note as a gap where a new ongoing commitment is created from income.
sufficiency.ifEvidenceAbsent: Potential Concern: affordability asserted with no income and expenditure record.

queryGroups.requirement: Financial situation plus cashflow supports the recommendation

queries.text: cashflow modelling projection of income and expenditure year on year to age
cashflow assumptions inflation rate growth rate used in the plan
figures entered into the cashflow model income sources and expenditure
no shortfall projected throughout your lifetime funds last
total net monthly income total monthly expenditure total monthly disposable income

comparison.tolerance: Every figure the report says was modelled must match the fact find within 5%.
falsePositiveGuards: Growth assumptions differ legitimately between a cashflow model and a provider illustration — flag only where the report relies on both without explanation.
Charts are not reliably parsable; do not conclude from a chart caption alone.

sufficiency.ifEvidenceAbsent: Note that cashflow conclusions are asserted with no modelling output on file.

queryGroups.requirement: Emergency fund and liquidity needs, foreseeable and unforeseeable

queries.text: you retain sufficient liquid capital to cover unexpected emergencies
emergency fund amount held in cash instant access savings
how many months of expenditure should be held in reserve recommended emergency fund
how long it takes to access funds working days disinvestment

falsePositiveGuards: An asserted sufficiency with no quantified requirement cannot be verified — record it as unquantified rather than as a contradiction.
Cash held may be earmarked elsewhere in the file; check for competing claims on the same money.

sufficiency.ifBothAbsent: Potential Concern: emergency fund and liquidity are named explicitly by this check.

queryGroups.requirement: Initial and ongoing commitments are unaffordable based on income, expenditure and cashflow

queries.text: impact of the charges on your fund value each year in monetary terms
can the client sustain the payments if income reduces or stops
net basic monthly income earnings frequency state pension amount frequency

comparison.tolerance: Flag where an ongoing income commitment exceeds evidenced monthly surplus.
falsePositiveGuards: Employment income due to cease within the term should be excluded from the surplus used for a long-term commitment.

sufficiency.ifEvidenceAbsent: Assess on the report alone and record that no surplus figure was available to test against.

queryGroups.requirement: Emergency funds not taken into account, or depleted or unavailable when required

queries.text: all of your available capital is being invested leaving nothing accessible
money withdrawn from the pension will be placed into your savings account

falsePositiveGuards: A transfer between pension wrappers does not deplete an emergency fund — only new money from cash does.

sufficiency.ifBothAbsent: No finding where no capital is being drawn from liquid savings.

queries.text: you cannot access this money until age 55 rising to 57 restrictions on withdrawal
notice period penalty for early withdrawal fixed term investment
when the client expects to need this capital and where it will come from

falsePositiveGuards: Pension access restrictions are irrelevant where the client is already over the minimum pension age — check age before flagging.

sufficiency.ifAssertionAbsent: Potential Concern where an access need falls inside a period the recommended wrapper restricts.

queryGroups.requirement: State Pension entitlement and other anticipated income sources

queries.text: your state pension is expected to start at age and provide you with per year
state pension forecast qualifying years entitlement per week
other expected future income rental income annuity or inheritance

falsePositiveGuards: A State Pension forecast quotes a weekly figure; annualise at 52 before comparing it with an annual figure in the report.
A forecast shows the amount at current qualifying years and the maximum if contributions continue; a report quoting the higher figure is not wrong, but should say which it used.
State Pension age differs by date of birth; check the client's own age before treating a difference as an error.

sufficiency.ifAssertionAbsent: Note as a gap where the affordability case depends on future income starting.
sufficiency.ifEvidenceAbsent: Potential Concern: future income relied on for affordability with no forecast or statement on file.

queryGroups.requirement: Planned future expenditure and foreseeable financial needs

queries.text: you have told me you expect to need capital for in the next few years
planned expenditure car home improvements wedding school fees
future capital requirement identified in the needs analysis

falsePositiveGuards: A future need recorded without a date is still a need; an undated plan is not an absent one.
Expenditure already inside the monthly budget must not be counted a second time as a future one-off.
A need the client described as aspirational is weaker evidence than a committed one, but it is not nothing.

sufficiency.ifAssertionAbsent: Note as a gap; the report should address known future calls on capital.
sufficiency.ifEvidenceAbsent: Potential Concern: a future need is asserted with no record of the client raising it.

decision.noIssue: Evidence complete, consistent and supports the outcome. Commitments are quantified and supported by evidenced income, expenditure and cashflow; the emergency fund is addressed; and the recommended wrapper permits access when the client needs it.
decision.potentialConcern: Material clarification or additional evidence required. Affordability is asserted without figures, cashflow inputs contradict the fact find, the emergency fund is unquantified or depleted, or capital is locked beyond a stated access date.
decision.notApplicable: Trigger absent. The case involves no capital, contributions, withdrawals or charges.
severityHints: Highest: capital inaccessible when the client has an evidenced need for it.
High: ongoing commitment exceeds evidenced surplus, or emergency reserves are consumed by the recommendation.
Moderate: cashflow inputs differ from the fact find figures.
Low: emergency fund asserted as sufficient but never quantified.
decision.overlayInstruction: Vulnerability overlay: consider whether any actual or potential drivers or characteristics of vulnerability, support needs, communication requirements or reasonable adjustments identified in the evidence materially affect this check's assessment or the conclusions it reaches. Where they do, say so in the finding. A vulnerability recorded in the file that has no bearing on this requirement is not itself a concern here — CHK-010 assesses vulnerability in its own right.
